blockers: The explicit reassignment × mapped-action/profile interaction is deterministically nested in the FUTURE_REASSIGNED condition and therefore duplicates information already represented by condition-specific structure unless the baseline mapped-action term is defined differently.
The current model still conflates a structural feature (mapped action under a permutation) with the experimental manipulation indicator.
The primary contrast is therefore not yet a clean difference-in-differences estimand of action×profile correspondence.

A cleaner formulation should define the action×profile response surface first and express the frozen permutation as a linear contrast over that surface, rather than adding a deterministic interaction column.
next_action: Reformulate NEXT4 as a permutation-indexed linear contrast over the action×profile coefficient surface: estimate the same action×profile surface across conditions, then contrast the coefficients along identity versus reassigned permutation cells.
